erin: Quick heads-up 52 - need final copycheck for internal release note and confirm rollback lanes before tonight's canary. Target deploy 23:15 UTC.

devon: Which model are we pinning hosted to for the canary? customers on dedicated should stay on current stable.

erin: Hosted -> model v2.4.0-rc, canary only. Dedicated remains on v2.3.3.

kai: Draft RN snippet: "Canary: hosted model v2.4.0-rc. Improvements: reduced KV miss rate, ~10% uplift on long-context throughput, and lower memory tail. No expected public downtime."

ops-oncall: I'll be on watch 22:45-00:30 UTC. Add me to the pin rotation and open #incidents if autoscale or p95 > 400ms.

devon: Rollback triggers: sustained p95 increase >25% for 10m OR error rate >1.2% for 5m. Rollback quick commands below.

devon: ```
# rollback quick
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/hosted-runtime hosted-runtime=registry/redwood/hosted:v2.3.3
./scripts/ops/notify_incident.sh --release v2.4.0-rc --reason auto-rollback
```

deploy-bot: [deploybot] queued: canary -> hosted-cluster-c; release=v2.4.0-rc; scheduled=2025-06-11T23:15Z. react :rocket: to proceed.

kai: Small edit to RN: change "~10% uplift" -> "typical uplift 5-12% depending on context length" and add link to perf dashboard.

erin: Updated RN. Final internal blast copy: "Canary deployed tonight at 23:15 UTC: hosted v2.4.0-rc. Target: improved long-context throughput and reduced KV misses. Ops oncall monitoring; rollback criteria and commands in thread. No user-facing downtime expected."

devon: Added canary knobs: BATCH_MAX=6 and PERF_SAMPLER=on for first 15m. I'll also post golden prompts by 22:55 UTC.

ops-oncall: Received. I'll paste live metrics to this thread if anything looks off.

erin: Thanks all. If no objections by 22:50 UTC we go headless. Drop any last smoke tests here.
